objective: Determine causally whether the dynamic Lead Opportunity system improves lead-level scheduled visits versus the current Growth prioritization/routing experience.

randomization.timing: At first production eligibility / lead creation, before any treatment-specific prioritization or routing.
randomization.allocation: 50/50 sticky for the entire 30-day experiment horizon
exclusions_before_randomization: internal/test/duplicate leads identified by production rules existing before experiment start
leads outside the Growth queue population the product is intended to prioritize
randomization.exclusions_after_randomization: None for ITT, except proven instrumentation corruption handled symmetrically and reported.
randomization.implementation: Server-side sticky assignment persisted before scoring; use permuted blocks within search_sector × search_modality × user_type when the production randomization service supports them. Assignment is immutable for the lead.

control.name: Current Growth prioritization
behavior: No exposure to the experimental Opportunity Score or experimental fallback ranking.

treatment.name: Dynamic Lead Opportunity system
behavior: Assignment occurs before any experimental scoring/routing.
Use a frozen drift-sanitized release candidate; E005/T1 with raw temporal/progress clocks is explicitly forbidden.
T0/T1 LeadQuality may influence queue ordering only if that stage passes the pre-launch future-cohort validation; otherwise that stage remains neutral/control-compatible for LeadQuality.
T1/T2 may refresh inventory serviceability and governed fallback when inventory data is available.
T2 may rank by the frozen sanitized LeadQuality only after its future-cohort gate passes.
Inventory serviceability uses current production inventory; historical backtests use backward-as-of state with >90d treated as unknown.
Missing/stale availability is surfaced as uncertainty and never silently treated as available.

primary_outcome.name: lead_scheduled_visit_30d_from_assignment
primary_outcome.definition: 1 if any unique backend broker_response == scheduled_visit event has response_event_at in (assignment_at, assignment_at + 30 days]; otherwise 0 after full 30-day maturation. Multiple events count once.
primary_outcome.estimator: Unadjusted intention-to-treat risk difference Treatment - Control.
primary_outcome.inference: Two-sided 95% confidence interval, alpha=0.05. Logistic/linear probability adjustment for pre-randomization strata and assignment week is a pre-specified precision/sensitivity analysis, not a replacement for the raw ITT estimate.

decision_rules: SHIP: point estimate >= +2.0 pp, 95% CI lower bound > 0, and all hard guardrails pass.
NO-SHIP: 95% CI upper bound < +2.0 pp; the experiment has ruled out the pre-registered minimum practical effect.
INCONCLUSIVE: all other cases; do not relabel as success based on secondary metrics.

power.planning_baseline: Use conservative p≈0.50 rather than the unstable historical 34.3% because strong cohort drift was observed.
power.note: If traffic cannot support this sample, pre-register a larger MDE before starting. Approximate conservative totals: 12,550 for 2.5 pp and 8,712 for 3.0 pp.

secondary_outcomes: lead-level any accepted_or_scheduled response within 30 days
number of Growth touches per lead if instrumented
close_90d/revenue_90d if production ground truth exists and matures later

operational: p50/p95 time to first broker response
fairness_monitoring: primary outcome by geography when support is sufficient

temporal_drift_controls.monitoring: Weekly blinded monitoring of covariate distributions and overall mature outcome rate. No treatment-effect peeking.
temporal_drift_controls.analysis: Report treatment effect by assignment week as secondary heterogeneity analysis and include assignment-week adjustment in sensitivity analysis.
temporal_drift_controls.stopping: Fixed sample / fixed maturation. No optional stopping based on interim treatment effect.

contamination_rules: Lead remains in the same arm for all T0/T1/T2 re-scores.
Control must not see experimental queue ordering or fallback recommendations.
Treatment failure to compute a score remains in treatment for ITT and counts against operational guardrails.
interpretation: The experiment tests the full system intervention, not the causal contribution of any single model feature.
Offline AUC/AP are not success criteria for the online test.
A significant secondary metric cannot override a failed/inconclusive primary outcome.

release_candidate_gate.outliers: keep unless an independent data-quality rule proves invalidity
release_candidate_gate.spot_price_totals: keep in v1 or remove only after an additional temporal confirmation because E025 strict non-inferiority was inconclusive
required_before_launch: production A/A assignment and outcome instrumentation PASS
final E028 release manifest populated with approved artifact/protocol/schema hashes
model/calibrator/feature schema/treatment policy frozen before first randomized lead
completed: Availability removed from LeadQuality and retained as serviceability/freshness guardrail
artifact/calibrator/schema hashes persisted in E029 candidate manifest

protocol_dry_run.purpose: A/A validation of target construction, assignment persistence assumptions, SRM plumbing and sample feasibility. It is not a causal effect estimate.
